Generate Aggregated Crude Death Output

generate_crude_death_outputs.Rd

Computes aggregated crude death counts and rates across new age bands from preprocessed demographic data. The function joins crude death rates to population weights, aggregates by new age groups, and compares total deaths before and after aggregation for consistency checking. Includes a diagnostic plot.

Usage

generate_crude_death_outputs(preprocessed, weight_reformatted, age_breaks)

Arguments

preprocessed

A list-like object containing demographic model inputs, with a component `processed_demographic_data$crude_death`.

weight_reformatted

A data.frame or tibble with columns `time`, `age`, and `value` providing population weights, usually long-format population data.

age_breaks

Numeric vector of age group cut points (e.g., `c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, ..., 80, 100)`).

Value

Invisibly returns `TRUE` if total deaths are preserved after aggregation. Also produces a diagnostic line plot (deaths by time, original vs. aggregated).
